description: The same problem met again in other words, 1 and 3 years apart. The sourdough case shares words on purpose, as a control: word matching should find it. The garden case is tagged on both sides.

fragments.title: Written updates before the weekly sync
fragments.body: Asked everyone to post what they did and what's blocking them in the team thread by Monday noon. The meeting itself shrank from an hour to twenty-five minutes and was spent on actual problems.

fragments.title: Daily check-in drags
fragments.body: Our morning check-in ran forty minutes again. Each person recites their tickets and nobody is listening until it's their turn.

fragments.title: ThinkPad dead in the bag
fragments.body: Kept finding it flat after carrying it around closed. Culprit: USB wake was enabled in the firmware setup. Turning it off fixed it; now it loses maybe 3% overnight.

fragments.title: New laptop battery drains while shut
fragments.body: Lid closed at night at 100%, and by breakfast it's down to 40%. Sleep doesn't seem to be real sleep.

fragments.title: Starter smells like nail polish
fragments.body: An acetone smell means the starter is hungry, not dead. Feed it twice a day at 1:1:1 for a few days and keep it somewhere warmer.

fragments.title: Starter acetone smell again
fragments.body: Back from the trip and the jar smells sharp. Should I throw it out?

fragments.title: Slugs ate the lettuce
fragments.body: Beer traps by the raised bed caught dozens overnight. Copper tape did nothing.

fragments.title: Protect the hostas
fragments.body: Leaves are full of holes this week.

cases.name: paraphrase: laptop drains shut, 3 years
cases.why: Shares only 'closed'; 'drains' and 'flat' don't match without meaning.

cases.name: control: sourdough acetone, 2 years
cases.why: Shares 'starter', 'acetone' and 'smell': word matching should get this one.

cases.name: tagged: slugs in the garden, 3 years
cases.why: Both tagged garden, as are several unrelated background notes.
